Guillermo's own take for Thu, Nov 12 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Save your energy for tomorrow and the weekend! There’s a small chance of wind at Porteau and Squamish from a leftover southerly under the clouds, but it could fade quickly. Erwin could work until about 11am, but it’ll be gusty and light.

I’d call this a good day to rest. The rain also washed a lot of debris into the water, so if you do get out, watch for logs and fallen branches from the storm.
